route.why: START HERE for quantum mechanics: why waves, the Schrödinger equation, probability and the box. Everything else builds on this
START HERE for solid state: what a crystal is (lattice and basis), the reciprocal lattice and how diffraction measures it
START HERE for astrophysics: how we measure stars (magnitudes, flux, distance) and what blackbody radiation is
First real quantum effect: a wave meets a barrier or a step (needs the wave-mechanics room)
Why atoms form crystals at all: bonding types and the energy between atoms
How light travels through gas: intensity, optical depth, the source function
The language of QM: states, operators, commutators, measurement, uncertainty
Atoms in a crystal vibrate: phonons, Einstein and Debye heat capacity
What holds a star up: hydrostatic equilibrium, virial theorem, Eddington limit
The most important exactly solvable system: ladder operators
Electrons as a classical gas: Drude model, conductivity, Hall effect
What powers stars: fusion, tunnelling and the Gamow peak
Rotation in QM: angular momentum and spin
Electrons are fermions: the Fermi sea (Sommerfeld) fixes what Drude got wrong
When stars die: degeneracy pressure, white dwarfs, neutron stars
Combining two spins: Clebsch-Gordan and Stern-Gerlach chains
The Fermi gas across courses: metals, white dwarfs and neutron stars side by side
The gas between the stars: phases, 21 cm line, Strömgren sphere
The hydrogen atom: levels, spectra, selection rules
Bands, gaps and effective mass: how semiconductors work
Rotation curves and dark matter
When exact solutions stop: perturbation theory, fine structure, Zeeman, Stark
Magnetism: Curie, Weiss, Heisenberg model
Supermassive black holes and quasars
Two particles, one state: EPR, Bell, CHSH
The Friedmann equations and cosmic expansion
BBN, recombination, the CMB
Mixed astrophysics exam practice
